title: Kazim Abbas - Portfolio Website
shortDescription: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React 19, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion showcasing award-winning projects and professional experience.
features: Modern Single Page Application (SPA) with smooth page transitions
Dynamic Project Showcase with detailed project pages and tech stack visualization
Interactive Contact Form with EmailJS integration and auto-confirmation
GitHub Stats Integration showing real-time contribution activity
Responsive Design with mobile-first approach and swipe navigation
Custom Animation System using Framer Motion and Tailwind
